deploybot: Starting pipeline for tag v1.12.0 -> staging. Commit: abcdef12. GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/commit/abcdef12. Jobs: build, unit-tests, lint.

samir: Noted, this is in today's change window (10:30-11:30 PT). Please surface any blocking failures ASAP.
deploybot: Build finished: SUCCESS. Unit-tests started.
jessica: Quick Q — last deploy saw flakiness in ranking-service tests. If unit-tests fail, prefer rerun once before pinning deps, right?
deploybot: Unit-tests result: FAILED (2 failing). Tests:
```
FAIL tests/ranking/test_ranker.py::test_top_k_consistency
AssertionError: Expected 10 got 9
FAIL tests/metrics/test_metrics_export.py::test_export_schema
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/metrics/test_metrics_export.py", line 42, in test_export_schema
    assert payload['version'] == '2.4.1'
AssertionError
```
maria: I can triage — looks like intermittent ranker flake + a metrics schema assertion. Two options: rerun unit-tests, or immediately pin metrics-lib to 2.4.1 in a quick patch. I'd try rerun first.
release-manager: Agreed with maria. Rerun once. If it reproduces consistently, open a pin PR with changelog entry and hold canary. For now do not rollback; not in prod.
deploybot: Rerun of unit-tests triggered by maria.
ci-bot: Unit-tests rerun: STARTED (job 2/3).
ci-bot: Unit-tests rerun: PASSED. All tests green.
samir: Nice. Proceed but keep an eye on the ranking-service metrics.
deploybot: Lint job started.
deploybot: Lint result: FAILED. 3 eslint errors in webapp/src/pack.js.
```
webapp/src/pack.js: line 12: 'unusedVar' is defined but never used. (no-unused-vars)
webapp/src/pack.js: line 78: Unexpected console.log. (no-console)
webapp/src/pack.js: line 102: 'processData' is not defined. (no-undef)
```

jessica: Those are from the dependency bump that changed a helper import path. I have a tiny fix in PR #7890 — it's just a one-line import and a whitespace lint. Can we merge and re-run lint?
release-manager: Fine to merge hotfix PR during staging. No release notes change required beyond a brief mention. Keep change window signoff.
maria: Merged #7890, re-running lint now.
ci-bot: Lint rerun: PASSED.

release-manager: For release notes draft: include bullet: "staging: lint hotfix merged; unit-tests rerun addressed intermittent ranking/metrics assertions." Maria will draft.
maria: Will draft and ping legal for the change window note. cc @samir for canary monitor.
samir: I'll watch canary metrics and post a follow-up. :eyes:
